_note: Faculty classification for the UI. status: PROPOSED = placement is the researcher's reading of Nigerian university practice and awaits the founder; OPEN = real universities disagree, the founder must decide. roster_pending = departments that belong in the faculty but have not been researched yet (names only, no course lists).

faculties.name: Allied Medical Sciences
open: nursing-science: many universities put Nursing in its own College of Health Sciences or in Medicine. Placed here because the user's list has no nursing faculty.

faculties.name: Pharmacy
open: Pharmacy is a faculty of its own at almost every Nigerian university and is not in the user's list. Kept separate; move it into allied-medical-sciences if the founder prefers.

faculties.name: Sciences
open: biochemistry and microbiology: universities split between Sciences and Applied/Life Sciences.

faculties.name: Banking and Finance
open: economics: sits in Social Sciences or Management Sciences at most universities; placed here because the user's list has no social-sciences faculty.

faculties.name: Law
open: Law is not in the user's list. Kept as its own faculty because the app already has it and no university merges it into another.

cross_cutting.name: General Studies
cross_cutting.note: University-wide core (GST/ENT). Shown to every student; not a faculty a student enrols in.
